questions.stem: In a queue of 52 candidates, a candidate is 20th from the front. After moving 4 places towards the back, what is the candidate’s rank from the back?
questions.explanation: Answer: 29. New front rank = 20+4 = 24. Back rank = 52 − 24 + 1 = 29.

questions.stem: In a queue of 59 candidates, a candidate is 13th from the front. After moving 3 places towards the back, what is the candidate’s rank from the back?
questions.explanation: Answer: 44. New front rank = 13+3 = 16. Back rank = 59 − 16 + 1 = 44.

questions.stem: A is the only daughter of D. D is the father of A. B is the son of A. F is the sister of D. How is D related to B?
questions.explanation: Answer: Maternal grandfather. D is the father of A, and A is B’s mother. Thus D is the maternal grandfather.

questions.stem: C is the brother of B. B is the mother of D. F is the father of C and B. How is C related to D?
questions.explanation: Answer: Maternal uncle. C is the brother of D’s mother B. Therefore C is the maternal uncle.

questions.stem: G is the mother of H. E is the daughter of H. B is the father of H. How is E related to B?
questions.explanation: Answer: Granddaughter. B is a parent of H, and E is H’s daughter. Hence E is B’s grandchild.

questions.stem: A surveyor walks 56 km west, turns right and walks 120 km, then turns right and walks 6 km. What is the shortest distance (km) from the starting point?
questions.explanation: Answer: 130. The first and third legs oppose each other. Net components are 50 km along the initial direction and 120 km perpendicular to it. Distance = √(50² + 120²) = 130 km.

questions.stem: A surveyor walks 26 km west, turns left and walks 32 km, then turns left and walks 2 km. What is the shortest distance (km) from the starting point?
questions.explanation: Answer: 40. The first and third legs oppose each other. Net components are 24 km along the initial direction and 32 km perpendicular to it. Distance = √(24² + 32²) = 40 km.

questions.stem: A surveyor walks 83 km west, turns left and walks 156 km, then turns left and walks 18 km. What is the shortest distance (km) from the starting point?
questions.explanation: Answer: 169. The first and third legs oppose each other. Net components are 65 km along the initial direction and 156 km perpendicular to it. Distance = √(65² + 156²) = 169 km.

questions.stem:
In a substitution language, each word has one distinct code. Code order is arbitrary.
secure digital credit = to ka su
secure banking access = vo ni ka
digital banking growth = to ni ze
credit access growth = ze su vo
secure digital growth = to ka ze
What is the code for “banking”?
questions.explanation: Answer: ni. Compare the intersections of the coded lines. The complete consistent mapping is: secure = ka, digital = to, credit = su, banking = ni, access = vo, growth = ze.

questions.stem: A container holds 190 litres of pure milk. 38 litres are removed and replaced with water. This process is repeated once more, mixing thoroughly each time. How many litres of milk remain? (Round to two decimal places if needed.)

questions.stem: A and B invest in ratio 3:3. A invests for 12 months; B joins later and invests for 3 months. A receives ₹104400 profit. What is the total profit (₹)?
questions.explanation: Answer: 130500. Profit ratio is 36:9. Each ratio unit = ₹2900. Total = 45 × 2900.

questions.stem: Two inlet pipes can fill a tank in 34 and 51 hours. An outlet empties it in 85 hours. All three open together. Find the time (hours) to fill the empty tank. (Round to two decimal places if needed.)
questions.explanation: Answer: 26.84. Net rate = 1/34 + 1/51 − 1/85 = 19/510 tank/hour. Required time = 26.84 hours.

questions.stem: [Table set] What is the difference between the total at B and the total at E?
questions.explanation: Answer: 40. Derived data: A: first category 720, second category 960; B: first category 540, second category 720; C: first category 360, second category 240; D: first category 1500, second category 900; E: first category 780, second category 520. Absolute difference = |1260 − 1300|.

questions.stem: [Table set] The combined total at A and D is what percentage more or less than the total at C? Give the absolute percentage difference, rounded to two decimals.
questions.explanation: Answer: 580. Derived data: A: first category 720, second category 960; B: first category 540, second category 720; C: first category 360, second category 240; D: first category 1500, second category 900; E: first category 780, second category 520. Percentage difference = |total(A)+total(D)−total(C)| ÷ total(C) × 100.

questions.stem: [Table set] A new branch F has a total equal to the average total at A and E. Its categories are split in ratio 2:3. What is the number in its second category?
questions.explanation: Answer: 894. Derived data: A: first category 720, second category 960; B: first category 540, second category 720; C: first category 360, second category 240; D: first category 1500, second category 900; E: first category 780, second category 520. Average total = (total A + total E)/2. The second category is 3/5 of that average.

questions.stem: [Table set] The rejected category at D is what percentage of the approved category at B? (Round to two decimal places.)
questions.explanation: Answer: 166.67. Derived data: A: first category 720, second category 960; B: first category 540, second category 720; C: first category 360, second category 240; D: first category 1500, second category 900; E: first category 780, second category 520. 900 ÷ 540 × 100 = 166.67%.

questions.stem: [Table set] What is the average number in the rejected category across A, C and E? (Round to two decimal places if needed.)

questions.stem: [Bar set] What is the ratio of the agricultural category at A and B together to the business category at D and E together?

questions.stem: A is twice as old as B. After 18 years their ages will be in ratio 3:2. What is the present sum of their ages?
questions.explanation: Answer: 54. Let B = x, A = 2x. (2x+18)/(x+18) = 3/2 gives x = 18. Present sum = 3x.

questions.stem: The average weight of 22 people is 29 kg. One person joins and the average rises by 1 kg. Find the new person’s weight (kg).
questions.explanation: Answer: 52. New total minus old total = (22+1)×(29+1) − 22×29 = 52.
